metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Analytics (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Derived Metrics for RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative analytics projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Analytics is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, and log.

coherence_score.label: Coherence Score
coherence_score.notes: Direct projection of measure.c1; no transformations allowed.

continuity_score.label: Continuity Score
continuity_score.notes: Direct projection of measure.c3; MUST NOT decrease across transitions.

stability_index.label: Lattice Stability Index
stability_index.notes: Projection only; authoritative value comes from session.state.

paradox_intensity.label: Paradox Intensity
paradox_intensity.notes: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry; density MUST be canonical.

harmonic_viability.label: Harmonic Viability
harmonic_viability.notes: Projection only; MUST NOT override authoritative state.

collapse_readiness.label: Collapse Readiness
collapse_readiness.notes: Projection only; collapse MUST be authoritative in session.state.

projection_rules: Analytics MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
Analytics MUST NOT invent measure values.
Analytics MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Analytics MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.

non_claims: Analytics does not revise RTT v0.9.
Analytics does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Analytics does not replace the human FFT book.
